name: Saishouji Riko
source:
A 2nd year student at St. Claus Academy. She is the daughter of the board chairman and is Yoshitaka's younger sister. Riko adores her older brother and is very much like a spoiled princess, but she is a good, honest girl at heart.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.zutto-otome.jp/memories/memories_chara/cha_girls.html]official website profile[/URL].]
